payload.instruction: transform the black DVD into a white DVD
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the transformed object remain identifiable as the same DVD?
node.criteria: The object whose color is changed remains recognizable as the DVD shown in SOURCE.
node.binding: Compare the object in SOURCE with the transformed object in EDITED to determine whether it remains the same DVD.
node.source_quote: transform the black DVD into a white DVD
node.endpoint: The transformed object remains identifiable as the DVD.
node.necessity: The instruction asks to transform the black DVD, so the requested color change must apply to that object.
node.zero_when: The DVD is not identifiable in EDITED, or the apparent change concerns a different object.
node.half_when: Some features support identifying the object as the same DVD, but substantial ambiguity remains.
node.full_when: The transformed object is clearly identifiable as the same DVD shown in SOURCE.

node_traces.evidence: The source DVD is the small rectangular case near the center, while the edited image shows two white circular discs in the scene. A white disc is present, but the original DVD case’s distinctive rectangular form and visible artwork are gone, and the two discs make it unclear which object corresponds to the source DVD. Some DVD-related identity is suggested by the disc shape, but the same DVD is not clearly identifiable.
